name: Human Raider
description: A hard-bitten raider from the coast or the strongholds, paid in overseas silver to keep the Dark Lands down. Most think they are doing honest work.

name: Alliance Ranger
description: A ranger who stayed when the alliance went home. They track goblins the way other people track deer.

name: Paladin
description: A fanatic in polished mail who believes every orc and goblin is a sleeping weapon. To an elf, they offer 'rescue' and a trial.

name: Paladin Champion
description: A stronghold's champion, sworn to finish the war the alliance walked away from.

name: Bound Goblin Sentry
description: An old goblin still keeping a post the Dark Lord gave it twenty years ago. It cannot leave, and it will not listen.

name: Bound Orc Guard
description: An orc of an older breed, still guarding what it was ordered to guard. It asks for a countersign nobody remembers.

name: Bound Orc Captain
description: A garrison captain holding until relieved, as ordered. The relief is never coming.

name: Beastman Trooper
description: A herd-born beastman soldier, a year old and already a veteran, loyal to whoever owns its unit.

name: Predator Beastman
description: A beastman made from predator stock and set loose behind enemy lines long ago. Some still raid; some have gone feral.

name: Deserter Beastman
description: A beastman who walked away from its army. Every free beastman is a deserter from somewhere.

name: Warbreed Hound
description: A flesh-crafted hound bred to run down slaves. The packs went feral when their masters died.

name: Cull Horror
description: A failed breeding experiment that should have been culled and was not. It remembers the vats.

name: Vat Spawn
description: Something that crawled out of a breeding lab's tanks when the power failed.

name: Flesh Crafter
description: A crafter of living things, worth more to a warlord than a hundred soldiers, and hunted by every orc and goblin who knows what they are.

name: Slaver
description: A dealer in beastman stock and stolen labor, armed and paranoid.

name: War-Engine
description: One of the Dark Lord's war machines, still running its last orders. Gnomes can sometimes talk it down.

name: Warlord
description: A would-be heir to the Dark Lord, holding crafters and herds, building a beastman army one birth at a time.
